Your roadmap for the term.
One session per week, and each row links the slides, the homework starter repo, and, after the
due date, the sample solution.

::: {.schedule-legend}
| | |
|---|---|
| {{< fa chalkboard >}} | **Slides.** The session's deck: concepts, theory, and the hands-on part. |
| {{< fa laptop-code >}} | **Homework.** Opens GitHub's new-repository page with the course organisation already selected. |
| {{< fa file-circle-check >}} | **Sample solution.** Published after the due date, for every homework. |
| {{< fa book >}} | **Resources.** Further readings and online learning resources for the week. |
| [{{< fa chalkboard >}}]{.schedule-tbd} | Greyed out means not published yet. |
| [none]{.schedule-none} | There is no homework in that session at all. |
:::

::: {.callout-important}
**Read this before you start a homework.**
Everything below decides whether your work is found and counted.

**There are 11 homework assignments, one in every session except the first and the last.**
The first session is orientation and the last is synthesis and the exam briefing, so neither sets
work.
Every session from week 2 to week 12 has exactly
one.
Week 1 and week 13 are marked [none]{.schedule-none} in the tables below.

**Every homework opens the moment its session ends, and is due 7 days later.**
So a homework assigned in one session is due before the next one starts.
The {{< fa laptop-code >}} link appears as soon as the homework is released, and the
{{< fa file-circle-check >}} sample solution appears once the deadline has passed.

**The {{< fa laptop-code >}} link opens GitHub's new-repository page, already filled in from the
week's template repo.**
Check two fields before you click "Create repository".

**Owner must stay `qmir-2026-fall`.**
The link pre-selects it, but the dropdown is editable and GitHub's own default is your personal
account.
A repo created on your personal account is invisible to the tracker and will not be counted as a
submission, no matter what is in it.

**Repository name must be exactly `hw-NN-<username>`,** with your own GitHub username.
The name is pre-filled as `hw-NN-USERNAME`, and `USERNAME` is a placeholder you replace.
The tracker looks the repo up by that exact name.

If the organisation does not appear in the Owner dropdown, you have not accepted your invitation
to the course organisation yet.
Check your email, accept it, and reload the page.
:::

## Take-home exam {#sec-exam}

::: {.callout-note}
**The exam is a complete 8-step Bayesian analysis.**
You see the target in week 1 and every week builds toward it.

**Window:** 9 December 2026, 15:30 to 23 December 2026, 23:59.

**Distribution:** the `exam` repo on the course org, the same template flow as the weekly
homework.

**Submission:** the state of your repository when the deadline passes is what gets graded.

**What to expect:** a dataset, the background you need, and a research question.
You run the analysis yourself, end to end, and submit a reproducible repository with a rendered
PDF.
Detailed grading criteria come with the exam.
:::
